result.goal: Build a Python expense summarizer for my weekly spending
result.summary: You're on track to build a Python expense summarizer. Keep practicing daily.

milestones.title: Get comfortable with values
milestones.subtitle: Turn text into something you can work with.
milestones.deliverable: Convert three text amounts into numbers and explain the difference.
milestones.reason: Understanding values is key to structuring your expense data effectively.

milestones.title: Make a little process
milestones.subtitle: Repeat one useful step across a collection.
milestones.deliverable: Add a list of expenses with a loop and check the total by hand.
milestones.reason: A little focused practice will support the next part of your project.

milestones.title: Find the shape in your data
milestones.subtitle: Give every category a place to keep its total.
milestones.deliverable: Create a dictionary with a correct total for each category.
milestones.reason: A little focused practice will support the next part of your project.

milestones.title: Build a reusable building block
milestones.subtitle: Wrap a clear step in a function you can test.
milestones.deliverable: Write a function that returns a category summary for sample expenses.
milestones.reason: A little focused practice will support the next part of your project.

milestones.title: Bring a real file to life
milestones.subtitle: Connect your logic to rows from a CSV file.
milestones.deliverable: Read a sample CSV using DictReader and print its category totals.
milestones.reason: A little focused practice will support the next part of your project.

milestones.title: Make something dependable
milestones.subtitle: Handle a missing file and an invalid amount.
milestones.deliverable: Run the tool on valid data and two broken inputs; explain each result.
milestones.reason: A little focused practice will support the next part of your project.
